_simulated: Public, case-specific scripted replies; no private evaluation labels.

rider_advocate.author: rider_advocate
rider_advocate.claim_restated: The trip went via Lavender MRT and stopped for three minutes. I did not ask for that detour. Please refund the full fare.

counter_arguments.argument: The Driver may have a justified route change or a Rider request.
counter_arguments.response: The Driver's own MSG-008-2 attributes the detour to a missed turn, and MSG-008-1 disputes consent. Ask only for the supported excess-fare remedy, not an automatic full refund.

rider_advocate.requested_outcome: Review the original full-fare request against consent and ADR 0004; grant only any supported excess-fare refund.

driver_advocate.author: driver_advocate
driver_advocate.claim_restated: The Driver acknowledges a missed turn and route-check stop, while opposing a refund of the legitimate baseline fare.

counter_arguments.argument: The Rider points to the excess distance, duration and charge.
counter_arguments.response: The excess is supported, and the Driver acknowledges the missed turn. A partial refund can preserve the legitimate optimal fare under ADR 0004.

driver_advocate.requested_outcome: Limit any refund to supported excess net fare.

judge.policy_fit_reason: Route communication and fare review clauses apply; ADR 0004 supplies arithmetic without changing policy text.
judge.reasoning_summary: Vehicle GPS establishes excess route distance and a bounded three-minute stop candidate. MSG-008-2 admits a missed turn and route-check stop, matching the reported excess; MSG-008-1 disputes consent. The full fare requested is not justified: ADR 0004 limits the refund to the code-computed excess net fare.
